text: Vanilla profile options that the Armoury of a Battle Company does not sell, so 'option has no matching armoury item' is expected and not a data defect. status `notSold`: no armoury item exists for it (the option is a banner, war horn or war drum, which the Battle Companies equipment table replaces with the Company Standard, Company Horn and Company Drum and which a 'Choice of Options' excludes; or it is Unique Wargear a company lists on its own page). status `readAs`: the option is read as an item the Armoury does sell (`armouryItem`), so it stays choosable and buyable as that item. status `ownItem`: the option is a weapon of its own that the Armoury does not sell but data.gearAnnotations describes (`item`, a Cave Troll's Troll Spear): choosable under its own name, no Armoury price. status `granted`: the model comes with it from the charts or the starting company and no Armoury entry sells it. A company whose armoury does sell the item (its Unique Wargear) is unaffected: this list only silences the check where no item matches.

profileWargearNotSold.text: Wargear that is part of a unit's vanilla profile but that no Battle Companies Armoury sells (profile armour and hand weapons, natural weapons, the Elven cloak...). A model of the unit always starts with it (it is added on recruit) but it can never be bought, and it is not an option to choose. Generated: every vanilla unit a company uses, every profile wargear whose item no armoury row, equipment or Unique Wargear names.
